items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: Then there was another clarinetist by the name of Billy Page

ctx.x: All right. No, I don't. Stump Evans was with King Oliver about the time that we're talking about. He was also occasionally at one of the show houses. Then there was another clarinetist by the name of Billy Page, who was around that time. Now, you think that the name Stump Evans sounds as familiar as anything that brought up nicely?
Yes. Uh-huh. It does. I should say so. Yes, it does.
